answer: The vertex multiplier is published, charged in willow, and island lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 18 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 766 identities would post 2328 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
